verdict.rationale: Zulip's own documented self-hosting option lets users install the same server software on a system of their choice. Its export/import tools let them move data between Zulip Cloud and their own servers, so they control where data lives. The evidence never frames this as region or residency selection, and nothing shows a choice of storage region within Zulip Cloud itself. Missing for 10: documented Zulip Cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: install a self-hosted Zulip server on a system of your choice
When you self-host Zulip, you get the same software as our Zulip Cloud customers.
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.
